class Mentor:
    def __init__(self):
        self._student = None

    def getStudent(self):
        return self._student

    def hasStudent(self):
        return self._student is not None

    def setStudent(self, aNewStudent):
        if aNewStudent is None:
            existingStudent = self._student
            self._student = None
            if existingStudent is not None and existingStudent.getMentor() is not None:
                existingStudent.setMentor(None)
            return True
        currentStudent = self._student
        if currentStudent is not None and currentStudent is not aNewStudent:
            currentStudent.setMentor(None)
        self._student = aNewStudent
        existingMentor = aNewStudent.getMentor()
        if existingMentor is not self:
            aNewStudent.setMentor(self)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        if self._student is not None:
            self._student.setMentor(None)
